idea: Our forty-person choir owns hundreds of scores in a cupboard and nobody knows what we have or who borrowed what. I want a catalog with borrowing, so the librarian stops being a human search engine.

problem: Before every concert we rebuy scores we already own because nobody can confirm the cupboard has enough copies.
user: One librarian maintains the catalog; members search and request; the conductor plans programmes from what we own.
workflow: The librarian catalogs each title with copy count; members borrow and return through her; the conductor checks availability when planning.
success: No duplicate purchases next season and every borrowed copy traceable to a member.
data: Roughly 400 titles, 10 to 50 copies each; title, composer, arrangement, and copy count matter; no sheet music scans in scope.
